edges.label: help, and a failure's usage line
the stated board, doing and version

beats.heading: Address one command
beats.body: The catalogue hands the session argv and the one route table. Help is answered first, from that table alone, before any flag is applied or any server contacted. Dispatch finds the named subcommand through the registry's lookup.

beats.heading: Capture context before dispatch
beats.body: Global flags take the board, version, doing text and session out of argv. A shared option the selected command does not read is refused before anything runs; the rest become facts the server client puts on every request.

beats.heading: Bound the invocation lifetime
beats.body: The interruptible run forwards SIGINT and SIGTERM as an abort and re-raises the signal once cleanup ends, or after a grace period. Failure reporting maps the error to a stable exit code, 5 for any refused board write, and writes the diagnostic.

nodes.name: Command routing
nodes.responsibility: Turns argv and the command table into one bounded invocation; callers outside reach it only through what its index exports
nodes.description: Callers outside the module import only src/cli/command-routing/index.ts. Every file under lib/ is private, so the parts the command catalogue reaches are the entry points that index re-exports (runCliWith, registryOf), and the rest are hidden parts.
